rationale: Reviewed after upgrading the compatible copies: vite 6.4.5, zod 4.6.7, @modelcontextprotocol/client 2.4.0, undici 8.12.3, fast-uri 3.1.9, fflate 0.8.3, protobufjs 7.6.6, and brace-expansion 5.0.12. The entries below still match advisories whose only fix is a breaking major. glob 13.0.6 is nested in pinned @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 0.80.10 and is patched only by glob >=14.0.2; the pi-coding-agent major bump was declined. minimatch is patched only in >=11.0.1, while eslint 10.13.0 depends on minimatch 10. image-size 1.2.1 is required by pptxgenjs 3.x (^1.2.1); the patched release is 2.0.3+ and npm's fix is pptxgenjs 4. zod 4 is installed at 4.6.7, which is outside GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5; the advisory range <4.6.6 still matches the zod 3.25.76 copies in agent-core, design-brain, pptd, and pptd-v2, and those packages cannot take zod 4 without an API migration. This exception does not accept new advisories or critical findings.
